verdict.rationale: The DGX B200 ships a software stack (DGX OS, health monitoring, Mission Control), so a telemetry opt-out is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence shows only health-monitoring and alerting tools, plus air-gapped deployment for the separate NIM product. Neither documents any control to opt out of telemetry or usage tracking.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
